items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: Winnie Manone made a record I can't remember any other records hardly

ctx.x: You know somebody was telling me and I didn't get this directly from Jim you might want to check up on this Jim now is supposed to be complaining because he has to play the melody because nobody else does you know and he then just swings back to the melody to help everybody

out. Yeah I'm not trying to criticize Jim because Jim's my favorite trombonist I'm not trying to make them I don't like his style or anything but there are tunes that he doesn't know there was one tune funny over at Preservation Hall last night Breeze I guess somebody requested the 1920s tune Breeze let's see Winnie Manone made a record I can't remember any other records hardly
